remarks.para: Issues and validates confidential access tokens for a tool using a symmetric realm key.

field.name: Initialized
field.summary: True after the access manager completes its first successful initialization.

field.name: RealmKey
field.summary: Symmetric realm key used to issue and validate confidential access tokens.

field.name: SignatureProcessor
field.summary: Optional signature processor mode used for signed issuance and for signature-validation fact generation during custom policy evaluation.

field.name: AccessKeys
field.summary: Subject-to-token membership map for active access tokens.

field.name: MembershipCache
field.summary: Bounded cache of resolved access token identities keyed by ciphertext-envelope characteristics.

field.name: KeyMaker
field.summary: Optional key-maker captured during construction for custom access-key construction.

field.name: KeyAssertionGenerator
field.summary: Optional access-key assertion generator mode used to resolve synchronous or asynchronous assertion generation at issuance time.

field.name: MembershipsByToken
field.summary: Authoritative token-to-membership metadata index for locally known memberships.

field.name: PolicyEngine
field.summary: Cached access-policy engine mode used for synchronous or asynchronous custom policy evaluation paths.

field.name: ManifestIdentity
field.summary: Cached tool manifest identity bound during access-manager initialization.

field.name: UsesDefaultPolicyEngine
field.summary: True when the cached policy engine is the singleton and the access manager can use its default fast path.

property.name: MyNoExceptions
property.summary: Suppress AccessManager exceptions when the owning tool has disabled exception propagation.

method.name: AddMembership
method.summary: Add AccessKeyToken membership for a subject.
method.returns: True if added or already present.

method.name: Authorize
method.summary: Determine whether an access key is currently valid for this tool context without requiring a protected operation.
method.returns: True if the key is valid for the manifest identity and membership set and passes access policy evaluation with a null operation; otherwise false.

method.name: AuthorizeAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously whether an access key is currently valid for this tool context without requiring a protected operation.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous authorization flow.
method.returns: True if the key is valid for the manifest identity and membership set and passes access policy evaluation with a null operation; otherwise false.

method.name: AccessCheckAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously whether an access key grants a tool operation resolved by name.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous access-check flow.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: AccessCheckIndexAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously whether an access key grants an explicit protected operation index.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous access-check flow.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: GenerateRealmKey
method.summary: Generate realm key bytes.
method.returns: Realm key.

method.name: GenerateAccessKeyAsync
method.summary: Generate asynchronously an access key of the requested type for the supplied subject using explicit issuance options.
method.param: Subject string to bind into the issued token.
Optional issuance settings including operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Access key used to authorize locked-tool issuance.
Cancellation token for the asynchronous generation flow.
method.returns: Generated access key, or null if generation fails, the requested type is unsupported, or issuance is denied.

method.name: ResolvePolicyEngine
method.summary: Resolve the cached access-policy engine and whether the current access manager uses the default engine fast path.
method.returns: None.

method.name: TryGetSignatureSigner
method.summary: Resolve the synchronous signer view used for signed access-key issuance from the configured signature processor mode.
method.returns: Synchronous signer, or null when signed issuance is not configured.

method.name: TryGetSignatureValidation
method.summary: Create signature-validation facts synchronously for a token secret using the configured signature processor when available.
method.param: Current manifest identity used to build the validation context.
method.returns: True when the signature-validation facts were created successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateSignatureValidationContext
method.summary: Create the immutable validation context passed to synchronous and asynchronous signature processors.
method.param: Current manifest identity used to supply realm, schema, and manifest facts.
Parsed outer signature metadata for the current key.
Canonical signed-region bytes for the current key.
Raw signature bytes for the current key.
Optional logger available to the configured signature processor.
method.returns: Immutable validation context.

method.name: CreateSignedUnverifiedSignatureValidation
method.summary: Create the default signature-validation facts for a signed key when no verification processor ran.
method.param: Parsed outer signature metadata for the signed key.
method.returns: Signed but unverified signature-validation facts.

method.name: CreateUnsignedSignatureValidation
method.summary: Create the default signature-validation facts for an unsigned key.
method.returns: Unsigned signature-validation facts.

method.name: CreateSignatureValidationAsync
method.summary: Create signature-validation facts asynchronously for a token secret using the configured signature processor when available.
method.param: Current manifest identity used to build the validation context.
Cancellation token for asynchronous verification work.
method.returns: Computed signature-validation facts, or null when the secret could not be parsed.

method.name: GetSynchronousSignatureProcessor
method.summary: Resolve the synchronous verification processor required by synchronous access-manager policy flows.
method.returns: Synchronous signature processor, or null when no synchronous verifier is configured.

method.name: ValidateSignatureProcessorMode
method.summary: Validate that the configured signature processor can participate in access-manager signing or verification flows.
method.returns: None.

method.name: NormalizeRequestedKeyType
method.summary: Normalize a requested key-type token into the canonical string used for policy and built-in issuance dispatch.
method.returns: Canonical requested key-type token, or null when the input is empty.

method.name: CreateRequestPolicyContext
method.summary: Normalize an access request into request-specific policy facts used by request evaluation and issuance dispatch.
method.param: Owning tool participating in request normalization.
method.returns: Normalized request policy context.

method.name: CreateRequestEvaluationContext
method.summary: Create the policy context used to evaluate whether a normalized access request should be allowed.
method.param: Optional logger to surface into the policy context.
method.returns: Policy context for request evaluation.

method.name: CreateAccessPolicyContext
method.summary: Create the policy context used for protected-operation access evaluation.
method.param: True when the access key matches the current manifest identity.
True when the access key is expired.
True when the access key is still an active membership.
Signature parsing and verification facts for the evaluated key.
True when the validated claims allow the protected operation.
Optional logger to surface into the policy context.
method.returns: Policy context for protected-operation evaluation.

method.name: CreateAuthorizationPolicyContext
method.summary: Create the policy context used for claim-only authorization evaluation.
method.param: True when the access key matches the current manifest identity.
True when the access key is expired.
True when the access key is still an active membership.
Signature parsing and verification facts for the evaluated key.
Optional logger to surface into the policy context.
method.returns: Policy context for authorization evaluation.

method.name: CreateIssueOptions
method.summary: Create normalized access-key issue options for internal issuance flows, using a single authoritative operations source.
method.param: Optional source issue options whose subject, lifetime, audiences, scopes, credentials, properties, requested assertions, and operations should be preserved or normalized.
method.returns: Normalized issue options.

method.name: CreateIssueOptionsFromRequestContext
method.summary: Create normalized access-key issue options from a normalized request context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.param: Normalized request facts to project into issuance settings.
Optional source issue options whose values override the normalized request context.
method.returns: Normalized request-driven issue options.

method.name: CreateIssuePolicyContext
method.summary: Create the policy context used for issuance evaluation.
method.param: Normalized issuance settings and authoritative protected-operation set.
Optional logger to surface into the policy context.
method.returns: Policy context for issuance evaluation.

method.name: CreateAssertionGeneratorContext
method.summary: Create the normalized access-key assertion generator context used after issuance policy approval and before final key material creation.
method.param: Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.returns: Normalized access-key assertion generator context.

method.name: CreateIssuanceContext
method.summary: Create the normalized internal issuance context shared across policy evaluation, assertion generation, token creation, and final key construction.
method.param: Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.returns: Normalized issuance context, or null when current issuance prerequisites are missing.

method.name: CreateIssueOptionsForRequestedKeyType
method.summary: Create normalized issue options that stamp a canonical requested key type onto the current issuance settings.
method.param: Requested key-type token to normalize into the returned options.
Optional source issue options whose remaining values should be preserved.
method.returns: Normalized issue options whose is authoritative.

method.name: GenerateKeyAssertions
method.summary: Generate access-key assertions for an approved issuance flow using the configured access-key assertion generator when one is available.
method.returns: Generated access-key assertions, or an empty array when no assertions are produced.

method.name: GenerateKeyAssertionsAsync
method.summary: Generate access-key assertions asynchronously for an approved issuance flow using the configured assertion-generator mode when one is available.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous assertion-generation flow.
method.returns: Generated access-key assertions, or an empty array when no assertions are produced.

method.name: CreateRevocationPolicyContext
method.summary: Create the policy context used for revocation evaluation.
method.param: True when the access key matches the current manifest identity.
True when the access key is expired.
True when the access key is still an active membership.
Signature parsing and verification facts for the evaluated key.
Optional logger to surface into the policy context.
method.returns: Policy context for revocation evaluation.

method.name: IssueRequestedAccessKey
method.summary: Issue the access key implied by a validated request policy context.
method.returns: Issued access key, or null when the requested key-type token cannot be constructed by the custom keymaker.

method.name: IssueRequestedAccessKeyAsync
method.summary: Issue asynchronously the access key implied by a validated request policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous request-driven issuance flow.
method.returns: Issued access key, or null when the requested key-type token cannot be satisfied.

method.name: IssueAccessKey
method.summary: Issue an AccessKey of the requested type using normalized issuance options.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including requested key type, subject, operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.returns: Generated AccessKey, or null if generation fails, the requested type is unsupported, or issuance policy denies the request.

method.name: IssueAccessKeyAsync
method.summary: Issue asynchronously an access key of the requested type using normalized issuance options.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including requested key type, subject, operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
Cancellation token for the asynchronous issuance flow.
method.returns: Generated access key, or null if generation fails, the requested type is unsupported, or issuance is denied.

method.name: IssueAccessKeyDispatch
method.summary: Issue access-key material for a canonical requested key-type token, then construct the final key instance through the custom keymaker if required.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.returns: Constructed access key, or null when issuance fails or no construction path supports the requested key-type token.

method.name: IssueAccessKeyAsyncDispatch
method.summary: Issue access-key material asynchronously for a canonical requested key-type token, then construct the final key instance through the custom keymaker if required.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
Cancellation token for the asynchronous issuance flow.
method.returns: Constructed access key, or null when issuance fails or no construction path supports the requested key-type token.

method.name: CreateIssuedAccessKeyMaterial
method.summary: Create issued access-key material after successful issuance policy evaluation, key-assertion generation, token creation, and membership-state updates.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
method.returns: Issued access-key material, or null if issuance cannot complete successfully.

method.name: CreateIssuedAccessKeyMaterialAsync
method.summary: Create issued access-key material asynchronously after successful policy evaluation, assertion generation, token creation, and membership-state updates.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes.
Optional normalized request policy context carried through request-driven issuance.
Cancellation token for the asynchronous issuance-material flow.
method.returns: Issued access-key material, or null if issuance cannot complete successfully.

method.name: EvaluatePolicyAsyncStatic
method.summary: Evaluate an access-policy engine mode asynchronously, preferring async evaluation when available and otherwise falling back to the synchronous engine.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous evaluation flow.
method.returns: Policy decision for the supplied context.

method.name: EvaluatePolicyStatic
method.summary: Evaluate a policy-engine mode synchronously for the supplied access-policy context.
method.returns: Policy decision for the supplied context.

method.name: GetSynchronousKeyAssertionGeneratorStatic
method.summary: Resolve a synchronous assertion generator from a configured assertion-generator mode for synchronous access-manager flows.
method.returns: Synchronous assertion generator, or null when no generator is configured.

method.name: ValidateAssertionGeneratorMode
method.summary: Validate that a configured assertion-generator mode exposes at least one supported synchronous or asynchronous execution contract.
method.returns: None.

method.name: ValidatePolicyEngineMode
method.summary: Validate that a configured policy-engine mode exposes at least one supported synchronous or asynchronous execution contract.
method.returns: None.

method.name: CreateBuiltInAccessKey
method.summary: Create a built-in library access key instance from issued ciphertext and a canonical requested key-type token.
method.returns: Built-in access key instance, or null when the requested key-type token is not one of the library's built-in key types.

method.name: RollbackIssuedAccessKeyMaterial
method.summary: Remove membership and cache state created during issuance when final key construction cannot complete.
method.param: Issued access-key material to roll back.
method.returns: None.

method.name: TryCreateCustomTypeAccessKey
method.summary: Try to construct a custom access key type using the configured for a canonical requested key-type token.
method.returns: True when a configured custom key-construction path created an access key; otherwise false.

method.name: MatchesAccessManagerQuery
method.summary: Determine whether resolved access-key claims satisfy the configured access-manager query filters.
method.returns: True if the resolved claims satisfy the configured query filters; otherwise false.

method.name: GetMembershipMetadataSnapshot
method.summary: Create a point-in-time snapshot of the authoritative membership metadata index.
method.returns: Authoritative membership metadata snapshot.

method.name: MatchesMembershipCatalogIdentity
method.summary: Determine whether a membership catalog is compatible with the manifest identity.
method.returns: True if the membership catalog carries no manifest identity or matches the manifest identity; otherwise false.

method.name: RemoveMembership
method.summary: Remove AccessKeyToken membership for a subject.
method.returns: True if removed.

method.name: RemoveMembershipMetadata
method.summary: Remove authoritative membership metadata for a token identity.
method.returns: True if removed.

method.name: SetMembershipMetadata
method.summary: Store authoritative membership metadata for a token identity.
method.returns: True if stored.

method.name: TryGetMembershipMetadata
method.summary: Try to get authoritative membership metadata for a token identity.
method.returns: True if the metadata exists; otherwise false.

method.name: QueryMembershipCatalog
method.summary: Query an authoritative membership catalog for the current access manager.
method.returns: An authoritative membership catalog matching the supplied query filters.

method.name: RequestAccessAsync
method.summary: Issue asynchronously a role-specific access key in response to an access request after request normalization and policy evaluation.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous request-access flow.
method.returns: Issued access key, or null if the request cannot be satisfied or request policy denies the request.

method.name: RevokeAccessAsync
method.summary: Revoke asynchronously an access key by removing its current membership if revocation policy allows it.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous revocation flow.
method.returns: True if the membership is revoked; otherwise false.

method.name: UpdateMembershipCatalog
method.summary: Update the current authoritative membership catalog using an explicit membership payload and update operation.
method.returns: True if the membership-catalog update succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: TryIssueToken
method.summary: Create a confidential symmetric token from the normalized internal issuance context.
method.param: Normalized issuance context containing manifest identity, issuer identifiers, subject, options, assertions, and diagnostics infrastructure.
method.returns: True if token created.
method.remarks: No membership side effects. The encrypted payload includes the current tool schema identifier, access-key realm identifier, issuer identifiers, manifest hash, optional audience and scope claims, and optional embedded assertions.

method.name: TryGetPolicyMembership
method.summary: Try to resolve an access key into authoritative membership metadata and compute the policy facts needed by authorization, access, and revocation evaluation.
method.param: Cached manifest identity associated with the evaluated key.
UTC instant used for the policy fact calculation.
True when the resolved membership matches the manifest identity.
True when the resolved membership is expired at the evaluation instant.
True when the resolved membership is still active in the subject membership set.
method.returns: True if the access key was resolved into authoritative membership facts and policy facts were computed; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetValidatedMembership
method.summary: Validate an access key against the manifest identity, expiration, and active membership set.
method.param: Cached manifest identity associated with the validated key.
UTC instant used for the expiration check.
method.returns: True if the resolved membership facts indicate a manifest match, an unexpired key, and an active membership; otherwise false.

method.name: IsActiveMember
method.summary: Determine whether a subject currently owns a specific access-key token membership.
method.returns: True if the membership is currently active; otherwise false.

method.name: InitializeManifestIdentity
method.summary: Initialize the cached tool manifest identity from the registry or the tool's default manifest projection.
method.returns: True if the cached manifest identity was initialized successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetManifestIdentity
method.summary: Try to get the cached tool manifest identity, initializing it on first use when needed.
method.returns: True if the tool manifest identity is available; otherwise false.

method.name: IsSignedAccessKeySecret
method.summary: Determine whether a serialized access-key secret is present and carries a signed outer envelope.
method.returns: True when the supplied secret exists and is marked as signed; otherwise false.
